newsitems.title: PUBG Esports анонсирует масштабные изменения на 2027 год: разделение регионов EMEA и Америка, Индия - новый регион
newsitems.contents:
Команда PUBG Esports пересматривает формат соревновательного календаря на 2027 год. 28 октября в официальном сообщении в Steam было объявлено о ряде нововведений: текущая региональная система будет пересмотрена, Индия станет полноценным соревновательным регионом, а прежняя система начисления очков на протяжении всего сезона будет заменена на формат из четырех отдельных этапов с единой турнирной таблицей.

Реорганизация затрагивает все уровни экосистемы: состав регионов, порядок отбора команд на серию турниров PUBG Global Series (PGS) и систему квалификации на главный турнир года — PUBG Global Championship (PGC).

Разделение регионов EMEA и Америка

Наиболее значимым изменением стало перераспределение регионов. Согласно заявлению PUBG Esports, обширный регион EMEA будет разделен на три части: Европа, Евразия и MENA (Ближний Восток и Северная Африка). Регион «Америка» будет разделен на Северную и Южную Америку. Кроме того, в качестве самостоятельного соревновательного региона добавится Индия — страна, где, как отмечается в анонсе, сформировалось огромное сообщество поклонников и игроков в PUBG.

Таким образом, структура регионов станет более детализированной по сравнению с форматом 2026 года, когда регионы EMEA и Америка были крупнее. В 2026 году уже проводились отдельные соревнования для Америки и EMEA (например, PUBG Americas Series 2 или PEC Fall Playoffs). Изменения 2027 года предусматривают более детальное разделение: команды, которые ранее выступали в рамках единого региона EMEA, теперь будут распределены по зонам «Европа», «Евразия» или «MENA».

Для команд это меняет условия квалификации: в более узких региональных рамках за одни и те же квоты на международные турниры будет бороться меньшее число коллективов, что, по мнению организаторов, открывает дополнительные возможности для новых претендентов. Для болельщиков же это означает появление новых региональных противостояний и больше сюжетных драм на протяжении сезона.

Четыре этапа вместо прежней системы турнирных циклов

В сезоне 2026 года соревновательная система включала 12 турниров серии PUBG Global Series, объединенных в четыре цикла, при этом очки для квалификации на PGC начислялись как в региональных лигах, так и на турнирах PGS. В 2027 году эта структура будет упразднена. Вместо этого PUBG Esports вводит четыре этапа (с 1-го по 4-й), в рамках каждого из которых региональная лига связана с соответствующим турниром серии PGS.

Результаты 1-го этапа определяют участников PGS 1, результаты 2-го этапа — участников PGS 2, и так далее вплоть до 4-го этапа. Достижения команды на одном этапе не переносятся на следующий: квалификация на PGS не гарантирует автоматического участия в последующих турнирах. Как отмечают в PUBG Esports: «Ваши результаты дадут вам новый шанс». На каждом этапе у новых претендентов появляется возможность пробиться на мировую арену, а опытным командам приходится постоянно подтверждать свой уровень, не полагаясь на успехи, достигнутые в начале сезона.

Такая четырехэтапная структура отличается от формата 2026 года, где восемь участников PGC определялись по итогам сезона в рамках общего зачета очков PGS. Новый формат дает перезагрузку несколько раз в год, что не позволяет командам расслабиться до конца сезона после одного удачного периода.

Единая система начисления очков

В 2027 году также унифицируется система квалификации. На смену двум системам, действовавшим в 2026 году (когда очки для PGC начислялись как за результаты в региональных лигах, так и за выступления на PGS), приходит единая система очков PUBG Esports. Теперь баллы можно получить только за успешное выступление на турнирах PGS; они накапливаются в течение года и учитываются при отборе на PGC.

Таким образом, выступления на международной арене становятся единственным критерием для попадания на чемпионат мира. Успехи в региональных лигах по-прежнему важны, поскольку это единственный путь на турниры PGS, однако они больше не приносят очков напрямую в зачет для квалификации на PGC. В PUBG Esports сообщают, что подробности распределения очков и полные правила отбора на PGC будут объявлены дополнительно.

Партнерские команды лишаются гарантированных слотов

Реорганизация также затрагивает программу «Глобальных партнерских команд» (Global Partner Team, GPT). С 2027 года формат GPT будет сфокусирован на внутриигровых предметах и маркетинговых мероприятиях. Гарантированные места в турнирах упраздняются: теперь все коллективы, включая нынешних партнеров GPT, должны завоевывать право на участие в PGS исключительно благодаря результатам в региональных лигах на каждом этапе — никаких гарантированных слотов больше не предусмотрено. Для организаций, ставших глобальными партнерами, это означает серьезное изменение в распределении рисков. Если раньше партнерство подразумевало определенные гарантии конкурентоспособности, то теперь оно ограничивается исключительно коммерческим сотрудничеством; при этом даже крупнейшие партнерские организации вынуждены проходить через тот же строгий отбор, что и претенденты, не имеющие партнерского статуса. Команда PUBG Esports сообщает, что более подробная информация об обновленной модели партнерства будет еще представлена.

Календарь 2027 года

Новый сезон открывается региональными лигами, и команда PUBG Esports представила предварительное расписание, которое будет действовать большую часть года:

Этап 1: конец марта – начало мая.

Этап 2: с середины мая до середины июня.

Кубок наций PUBG 2027: начало июля

Этап 3: с начала августа до середины сентября.

Этап 4: конец сентября – начало ноября.

Чемпионат мира по PUBG 2027: конец ноября — начало декабря.

В объявлении отмечается, что расписание может быть изменено, а подробные расписания, форматы и информация о турнирах Региональной лиги будут опубликованы позже.

Что значат все эти изменения

Структуру 2027 года лучше всего воспринимать как прямой ответ на ограничения формата 2026 года. Новая модель решает проблемы прежней системы: разукрупненные регионы дают возможность попасть на глобальную арену большему количеству команд, а с четырехфазным ритмом и единой таблицей очков следить за сезоном становится проще.

Присоединение Индии - очевидный признак роста. В Индии имеется огромная база фанатов PUBG, и предоставление стране собственного конкурентного региона открывает прямой путь для индийских команд и формирует аудиторию для этих матчей. Этот шаг ведет как к увеличению доходов и количества зрителей, так и к росту соревновательной конкуренции.

Изменение партнерской программы влечет за собой серьезные последствия для организаций. Потеря гарантированных мест PGS устраняет основной конкурентный стимул программы GPT и заставляет партнеров оставаться конкурентоспособными на каждом этапе или потерять свое место на международых турнирах. От того, как отреагируют партнерские организации, будь то расходы на состав или переосмысление своих обязательств по PUBG, будет зависеть не только сам новый формат, но и начало сезона 2027 года.

Точное распределение очков PUBG Esports, механика квалификации PGC и форматы региональных лиг появятся в последующих обновлениях.

newsitems.title: PGS 12 Survival Stage is LIVE!!
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]The final stretch of the 2026 PUBG Global Series is approaching: [b]PGS Circuit 4[/b]. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and the Circuit Final, PGS 12, the three remaining tournaments will bring this year’s 12-event PUBG Global Series to a close.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 4 is more than just the final circuit of the season. With the conclusion of PGS 12, the [b]final PGS Points standings for the 2026 season will be determined, deciding the eight teams that will advance to PUBG Global Championship 2026.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After three circuits of competition, the race for PGC is beginning to take shape—but nothing has been decided yet. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and double points on the line at PGS 12, there are still [b]240 PGS Points[/b] up for grabs.[/p][p align="start"]Which teams will earn their way to PGC 2026 through PGS Points? Let’s take a closer look at [b]Circuit 4, the final competition of the 2026 PGS season.[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/QYvMFGPC.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS Circuit 4 Schedule[/b][/h2][p align="start"]PGS Circuit 4 will take place from [b]October 14 to November 1[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]PGS 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Group Stage: October 14[/p][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: October 15[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 16[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 17–18[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 11[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winners Stage: October 22[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 23[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 24–25[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 12[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: October 29[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: October 30–November 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the [b]Circuit Final[/b], PGS 12 will see the top eight teams in the Circuit 4 PGS Points standings advance directly to the Grand Finals based on the points accumulated through PGS 10 and PGS 11. The remaining 16 teams will compete in the Survival Stage for the remaining spots in the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"]When PGS 12 comes to an end, it will mark not only the conclusion of Circuit 4, but also the end of the [b]2026 season-long PGS Points race spanning PGS 1 through PGS 12.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/dfU4pJIb.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b] [/p][h2][b]PGS Points Standings[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With three circuits and nine PGS events now complete, the battle for PGS Points is more intense than ever.[/p][p align="start"]At the conclusion of Circuit 3, [b]Virtus.pro leads the standings with 261 points[/b], followed by Made in Thailand with 224 points, 17Gaming with 223 points, and T1 with 208 points.[/p][p align="start"]Currently occupying the final PGC qualification spot is [b]Petrichor Road in eighth place with 152 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]But the gaps around the cutoff remain narrow. Seventh-place Falcons sit just two points ahead at 154, while ninth-place Gen.G Esports trail the current PGC qualification line by only seven points with 145.[/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, [b]Circuit 4 is still to come.[/b] The current standings are far from the final picture of who will advance to PGC.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/WQDtO1dg.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGC 2026 Qualification & PGS Points[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The [b]top eight teams in the final PGS Points standings[/b], accumulated across PGS 1 through PGS 12 during the 2026 season, will qualify for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And the final standings determine more than just qualification. The higher a team finishes in the PGS Points standings, the [b]later the stage from which they will begin their PGC 2026 journey.[/b][/p][p align="start"]The team finishing [b]1st in PGS Points will advance directly to the PGC 2026 Grand Finals[/b]. The [b]2nd-place team will enter at Survival Stage Day 1[/b], while the teams finishing [b]3rd through 8th will begin their journey in the Qualifying Stage[/b].[/p][p align="start"]This means Circuit 4 is about more than simply breaking into the Top 8. For teams already inside the qualification zone, the battle will continue until the very end as they fight for a higher PGS Points ranking and a more advantageous PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]240 PGS Points Are Still Up for Grabs[/b][/p][p align="start"]In both [b]PGS 10 and PGS 11[/b], the winner will earn [b]60 PGS Points[/b], with points awarded down through 16th place.[/p][p align="start"]At the Circuit Final, [b]PGS 12, the points will be doubled[/b]. The winner will earn 120 points, with 96 points going to second place, and double the PGS 10 and PGS 11 point values applied throughout the standings.[/p][p align="start"]That means the maximum number of points a single team can earn in Circuit 4 is:[/p][p align="start"][b]60 points (PGS 10 1st) + 60 points (PGS 11 1st) + 120 points (PGS 12 1st) = 240 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Considering the current gaps both inside and outside the PGC qualification zone, the three remaining tournaments leave plenty of room for the final standings to change.[/p][p align="start"]For teams outside the Top 8, Circuit 4 represents one final opportunity to make their move. For those already inside, it will be the final test to defend their position and secure a higher PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261012/lwSlSIQk.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS 10 Groups[/b][/h2][p align="start"]And it all begins with [b]PGS 10[/b].[/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage groups have been confirmed for the 24 teams competing in PGS 10. The teams have been divided into Groups A, B, and C through a [b]snake seeding format based on the final results of PGS 9.[/b][/p][p align="start"]PGS 9 winner Gen.G Esports has been placed in Group A, second-place T1 in Group B, and third-place Falcons in Group C. From there, the direction of placement alternates according to the PGS 9 standings, distributing all 24 teams across the three groups.[/p][list][*][p][b]Group A:[/b] Gen.G Esports, Made in Thailand, Virtus.pro, TEAM LIQUID, DN SOOPers, Sharper Esports, Team Vitality, Natus Vincere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B:[/b] T1, Alpha Gaming, Team Flash, eArena, Petrichor Road, FULL SENSE, TYLOO, JD Gaming[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C:[/b] Falcons, Geekay Esports, Anyone’s Legend, 17Gaming, FOUR ANGRY MEN, Twisted Minds, 09(Team Nemesis at PGS 9), Godlike[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="start"][b]\[Updated: October 12][/b][/p][p align="start"]Following GAM The Expendables’ withdrawal from PGS Circuit 4, Team Flash has been selected as the replacement team based on its placement in PVS Phase 1, in accordance with the existing team qualification criteria.[/p][p align="start"][i]※ Further updates will be provided if there are any changes to the tournament.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][h2][b]The Final Step to PGC[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The 2026 PUBG Global Series journey that began with PGS 1 now has just three tournaments remaining.[/p][p align="start"]There is still everything to play for after Circuit 3. With 60 points available at each of PGS 10 and PGS 11, followed by 120 points at PGS 12, [b]a total of 240 points remain on the table—and a single strong finish could reshape the race to PGC.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Which teams will finish inside the final Top 8 and earn their place at PGC 2026? And which team will rise to the very top of the standings to secure a direct seed to the [b]PGC Grand Finals[/b]?[/p][p align="start"]The final competition of the [b]2026 PUBG Global Series[/b] is about to begin.[/p][p align="start"][b]Tune in and cheer on your favorite teams as they make their final push toward PGC 2026![/b][/p]

newsitems.title: 2027 PUBG Esports: What’s Changing
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents: [p]In 2027, PUBG Esports will introduce a new competitive structure.[/p][p]With updates to the existing regional competition system and the introduction of four Phases throughout the year, we aim to create a new competitive environment where more teams can compete for a place on the global stage and prove their skills.[/p][p]Take a closer look at the new competitive structure and key changes below.[/p][p][b]Regional Competition Updates[/b][/p][p]In 2027, PUBG Esports will introduce changes to its regional competition structure, including the division of existing regions and the addition of a new region.[/p][p]The existing [b]EMEA[/b] region will be divided into [b]Europe, Eurasia, and MENA[/b], while the [b]Americas[/b] will be divided into [b]North America and South America[/b]. [b]India, home to a massive community of PUBG fans and players, will join as a new competitive region[/b], creating more opportunities for teams to compete on the global stage.[/p][p]The race to qualify for PGS begins in each Regional League. Established teams and new challengers alike will compete at the regional level, with their results determining who advances to the global stage. With the updated regional competition structure, fans can look forward to new rivalries, new contenders, and more stories unfolding throughout the year.[/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261028/hpZM4KJD.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][b]Four Phases, Four Chances[/b][/p][p]PUBG Esports in 2027 will feature four Phases, from Phase 1 through Phase 4.[/p][p]Each Phase consists of Regional Leagues and the corresponding PUBG Global Series (PGS).[/p][list][*][p][b]Phase 1[/b]: Regional League: Phase 1 → [b]PGS: Phase 1[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase 2[/b]: Regional League: Phase 2 → [b]PGS: Phase 2[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase 3[/b]: Regional League: Phase 3 → [b]PGS: Phase 3[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase 4[/b]: Regional League: Phase 4 → [b]PGS: Phase 4[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Each Phase brings a fresh opportunity to qualify for PGS, and securing a spot in one Phase does not guarantee participation in the next. [b]New challengers will have the chance to reach the global stage, while established teams must continue to prove themselves.[/b][/p][p]As part of this competitive restructuring, starting in 2027, [b]the Global Partner Team (GPT) program will evolve into a partnership focused on collaborative in-game items and marketing activities.[/b] All teams, including existing GPT teams, [b]will need to earn their place at PGS through their performance in each Phase’s Regional League, without guaranteed slots.[/b] Further details on the updated partnership will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p][b]The next chance is earned through performance.[/b] Each of the four Phases brings a fresh challenge, creating new stories on the global stage.[/p][p][b]Introducing PUBG Esports Points[/b][/p][p]In 2027, [b]PUBG Esports Points[/b] will replace the existing points systems. Previously, PGC Points were awarded based on Regional League results, while PGS Points were awarded based on PGS results. Under the new system, [b]points will be awarded exclusively based on performance at PGS.[/b][/p][p]Teams will earn PUBG Esports Points based on their results at PGS. These points will accumulate throughout the year and count toward qualification for PGC. While the race from the Regional Leagues to PGS continues with each Phase, results achieved on the global stage will build throughout the year through PUBG Esports Points.[/p][p]Further details on the points distribution and PGC qualification system will be announced separately.[/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261028/yZdRyXdt.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][b]2027 PUBG Esports Schedule[/b][/p][p]PUBG Esports in 2027 will begin with the Regional Leagues.[/p][p]Phase 1 and Phase 2 will take place in the first half of the year, followed by the 2027 PUBG Nations Cup in July. Phase 3 and Phase 4 will continue in the second half of the year, before the year concludes with the 2027 PUBG Global Championship.[/p][list][*][p][b]Phase 1[/b]: Late March – Early May[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase 2[/b]: Mid May – Mid June[/p][/*][*][p][b]2027 PNC[/b]: Early July[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase 3[/b]: Early August – Mid September[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phase 4[/b]: Late September – Early November[/p][/*][*][p][b]2027 PGC[/b]: Late November – Early December[/p][/*][/list][p]* The schedule above is subject to change.[/p][p]The changes coming in 2027 go beyond the competitive structure. Alongside the updated competition system, [b]a new look for PUBG Esports is also on the way. [/b]Stay tuned for more updates as PUBG Esports prepares for 2027.[/p][p]Further details on each Regional League’s schedule and format, PUBG Esports Points, and other tournament information will be shared in future updates.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]PUBG Esports Team[/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone - Season 1
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:

Brave the chaos and use its relentless pace of engagements to level up those crucial early Weapon ranks, so you’re ready to go when the Season 1 Multiplayer maps arrive.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Possession (Pre-Season: October 29)[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b748870b24afb66c27e4ed668354c3744566b0a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For the Halloween season, Possession is a fast, visceral party mode moshpit. Eliminate enemies to fly across the map to get on the Hardpoint, or to clear a Search and Destroy bombsite. But beware, you’ll always possess an eliminated enemy, so check your targets before committing to the kill.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infected (Pre-Season: October 30)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae73b11a2a270fc7f4a110a9c3d74c66785553e3.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s Survivors vs. the Infected in this team-based party mode where one player is randomly assigned to the Infected team at the start of the match. Every time the Infected player eliminates a Survivor, that player joins the swarm of the Infected. If you’re Infected, eliminate as many as you can to bolster your ranks. If you’re a Survivor, hold out as long as you can against the hordes of Infected.[/p][p]The Infected are all about speed and stealth, equipped with the FSS Carbon Edge Combat Knife, a Throwing Knife, and the Ninja Perk to assist in their shambling sneak attacks. [/p][p]Infect everyone or survive the game to win.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Grind (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/34ef7f701f92b2f83d218cee40e12eac20ffb714.png"][/img][/p][p]Eliminate players, recover their dog tags, and take them to the Bank to score in Grind. There are two Bank on the map, and both teams can deposit their carried dog tags in either one. Operators can carry multiple dog tags and will drop all carried tags upon being eliminated. Swoop them up and drop them at the Bank to score big.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Drop Zone (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bc55c977736f35599ef9ab8a26c64e4f5f56e332.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d23f3c4844039390c6c4acc8efcbe0e8208a34e2.png"][/img][/p][p]The rich get richer in Drop Zone, where teams fight to hold a single rotating objective. For the best results, close the distance and unleash.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: CSG Crossfire[/b][/p][p][i]Dual-wield akimbo CSG-35 SMGs and trade accuracy for a wave of downrange chaos.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: JAK 12 (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Shotgun, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ca2024be1c2664d74e2d3c7355c6a9f6f46941c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED][/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 8[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 16[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 323 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Event.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ee6adebf2fe6d5fc568039cf116d149be140b1d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Devastate close-ranged targets with this full-auto Shotgun that showers foes with a cluster of pellets. Its accuracy falls off quickly, and it kicks hard after each shot, so closing the distance is required. The JAK 12 excels as a breaching tool; if you anticipate enemies on the other side of that closed door, barge through and tear them to shreds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: JAK Barrage[/b][/p][p][i]Launch a salvo of adhesive explosives that stick to surfaces and targets before detonating with devastating results.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Melee Weapon: ZLR Talonhawk (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4f6f43722f442876e9b8dce57bee3313b746991.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 10[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Event.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] None[/p][p]Attack foes with a variety of hacks and slashes using this deadly Combat Axe, its heft capable of inflicting heavy damage to the unlucky recipients of its blade. [/p][p][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/137a7faf64751f92158dc1fe630908692c1f084b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hyeon Auto Apex Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle, Wager Match Event Reward[/i][/p][p]Converted to fully automatic fire, the Hyeon Auto was built for laying down stable, rapid fire. Offering a substantial increase in continuous RPM over the burst fire/semi-automatic variant, this weapon relies on firepower over precision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kastov 545 Apex Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Wager Match Event Reward[/i][/p][p]The Kastov 545 fires 5.45x39mm rounds, offering smooth handling and rapid follow-up shorts without sacrificing combat effectiveness.[/p][p][/p][p][b]M16 Burst Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]M4 Assault Rifle, Event Reward[/i][/p][p]Give the M4 the M16 treatment. Equip the M16 Burst Attachment to trade full-auto fire for controlled bursts. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Attachments (In-Season)[/b][/p][p]Adjust your weapon arsenal still further with more Attachments to unlock, including the TT Iron Guard Kit for the .50 GS Pistol, and the ChainSAW Grip set for the FiNN LMG.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 1 Events: Initial Intel (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45ca91fa7d0fa10cefa7398b23d557f010ed0590.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Season 1 kicks off with the new Wager Match Event, plus additional Events as the season progresses. Participate and unlock an impressive array of rewards including new weapons, Weapon Attachments, Weapon Blueprints, Camos, Operator Skins, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Event: Wager Match (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: New Attachments, Operator Skin, Weapon Blueprint, Weapon Camo[/i][/p][p]Fight for top billing in the Wager Match Event*, where Trophies are the currency and collecting more of them earns valuable rewards including multiple Weapon Attachments. Enter the Gauntlet 1v1 Gunfight playlist in Multiplayer, and other challenges across DMZ and Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][p]Compete for extra rewards if you’re one of the top three winners, and Mastery Rewards to chase along the way, including an Operator Skin, Blueprint, Weapon Camo, and multiple weapon Apex Attachments. [/p][p][i]*No money or items of real-world value are available by participating.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Events (In-Season, Mid-Season, MP, DMZ, WZ)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Camo Events:[/b] Play matches to earn XP and acquire Weapon Camos.[/p][p][b]Joint Fire Event:[/b] While you can go solo in this party up Event, there’s a big boost to your progress if you Squad Up. Bring in your Friends to activate an XP Boost that increases for larger squads, and unlock rewards including Blueprints, Charms, 2XP Tokens, a DMZ Survival Kit, and more.  [/p][p][b]Additional Events:[/b] Look for more events coming at Mid-Season.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell [/h3][p][b]Guaranteed Value and a New Streamlined Battle Pass System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/240b10bd61170c881c911a822a6fcff1dfa6c3c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass is packed with 100+ Rewards, including a brand-new catch-up system that guarantees 50+ rewards in the premium Battle Pass for those who purchase it. In addition to the normal unlocking of Battle Pass content, players who fall behind in the premium Battle Pass will be automatically caught up to the Reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50. [/p][p]The Battle Pass itself is easier to navigate, too: Log in to collect your rewards and keep playing to unlock a linear 100-tier track filled with additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves, Calling Cards, Weapon Charms, Reticles, and more.[/p][p]Purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 1 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to gain access to the new catch-up system and to immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards, including the following items:[/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the duration of Season 1[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Up to 1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Downpour” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Downpour BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Fortune’s Favor” FiNN LMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Happy Boom” Grenade Lethal Equipment Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Killing Demon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, and more, including new items such as DMZ Survival Kits. Expect to unlock the following as you progress through the Battle Pass:[/p][list][*][p]New Base Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Charms[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Emblems[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Calling Cards[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Double XP Tokens (Player, Weapon, and Battle Pass)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Blueprints[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finishing Moves[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Equipment Skins[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Decals[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kits[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Season 1 Battle Pass Completion Rewards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7bd5ece6469f0c794933d311ef87c4a6dbd312a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Players who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass and complete all 100 tiers will earn the following completion rewards:[/p][list][*][p]The “Vantage” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Vantage BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Blue Viper” Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]200 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Honor’s Harbinger” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Virtue’s Snarl” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Ultra Weapon Blueprint Tier 100 Reward[/b][/p][p]And that’s not counting the Tier 100 reward itself, the “Bellum” Ultra rarity Mosin-Nagant Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bonus Rewards[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Later in the season, players who have purchased the premium Season 1 Battle Pass and completed all 100 tiers get the chance to unlock a special set of additional game rewards. For Season 1, there are eight additional Operator Skins you won’t want to miss! Stay tuned for more intel when the Season 1 Reloaded Blog drops.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Offerings[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c40f66368ba28bd7121394d356824039e07697f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The BlackCell faction is now active across all theaters of operations. BlackCell users will gain immediate access to the first of a trio of BlackCell Skins for Agents arriving in Season 1 under the name XERO. The clandestine XERO leads a team of additional Operators clad in Skins and carrying Weapon Blueprints earned exclusively through BlackCell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Vault Edition Owners: BlackCell Access Granted![/b][/p][p]If you obtained the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, you can unlock this season’s BlackCell offering. [/p][p]If you obtained the Digital Standard Edition of Modern Warfare 4, you can upgrade to the Vault Edition later, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, unlocking [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/705521410310669069"]the many Vault Edition benefits detailed here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 1 BlackCell[/b][/p][p]BlackCell owners can access the Season 1 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:[/p][list][*][p]The “XERO” BlackCell Operator plus the “Cowled” and “Adder”Operator Skin variants available via BlackCell Challenges[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Perimeter Lance” M4 Assault Rifle Signature Weapon Blueprint plus the “Occultus” and “Exitium” Signature Weapon Blueprint variants available via BLackCell Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dog Food” Companion Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A Custom BlackCell Lobby Scene[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mastery Camo Track[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]20 Tier Skip Tokens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Pack[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and during Match After Action Reports)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]BlackCell owners get access multiple rewards within the Season 1 Battle Pass, including:[/p][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Operator Skins for Blix (two Skins), Oh-Ji, Velikan, Min-Hee, Luca, and Dallas.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Weapon Blueprints for the Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Axion Assault Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle, ISO Nightshade SMG, CSG-35 SMG, Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle, and the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional DMZ Benefits, to be detailed prior to Season 1 launch.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator and Weapon Challenges[/b][/p][p]In addition to the Operator Skin variants for XERO, and the Signature Weapon Blueprint variants, you can unlock exclusive Universal Weapon Camos by completing BlackCell Camos. What exactly are these Camos? You’ll find out in the coming days![/p][p][/p][h3]Operators[/h3][p]Get more intel on Season 1 featured Operators XERO and Blix, who both excel in the art of stealth and precision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]XERO (BlackCell, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]BlackCell Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3ce64bad7632ae525deffb3a04087c02899b0252.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There is no record of XERO before BlackCell. Not an erased record. Not a sealed record. Nothing. The earliest known reference to him appears inside a classified BlackCell development program involving behavioral conditioning, synthetic identities, experimental combat training, and neurological augmentation. [/p][p]Whether those skills were taught, implanted, or recovered from a life XERO no longer remembers remains classified. His designation originates from X-0, an internal prototype number found repeatedly throughout damaged BlackCell archives. Later documentation replaces X-0 entirely with a single name: XERO. [/p][p]Field personnel describe him as unnervingly controlled. He demonstrates familiarity with locations he has supposedly never visited and occasionally recognizes people who insist they have never met him. Certain sounds, symbols, and encrypted transmissions have triggered brief episodes of memory that do not correspond with anything in his official history. [/p][p]BlackCell refuses to explain them. Some within the organization believe XERO was a volunteer whose identity was deliberately erased. Others believe he was assembled from the remnants of multiple failed subjects. A more disturbing theory persists among those with access to the original program: BlackCell did not erase XERO's past. They created one where none existed. [/p][p]Today, XERO operates as one of BlackCell's most closely controlled assets, deployed when an operation requires complete deniability. No country can claim him. No agency can identify him. And if BlackCell's files are accurate, XERO may not know enough about himself to ever leave them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blix (Battle Pass, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ee728f8beea1ca1f0167f0c398dc3c676e8ef02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A former elite operator within South Korea’s Special Warfare Command, Blix’s trajectory shifted permanently after a covert border mission led to his capture and extended imprisonment. Enduring extreme hardship, he survived the ordeal only to be funneled through a network of foreign captives and deployed into high-intensity proxy conflicts.[/p][p]On the battlefield, his perspective on combat transformed into a rigid, absolute philosophy. Blix began tattooing fragments of survival codes and tactical doctrine across his skin, turning his body into a living archive of warfare. His mechanical efficiency and complete indifference to physical trauma caught the attention of the masked mercenary leader Nikto, who pulled him from the ranks to serve as a premier operative. Now deploying into the Exclusion Zone, Blix executes his objectives with silent, disciplined precision, viewing the theater of war not as a duty, but as an absolute doctrine.[/p][p][/p][h3]Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8a476c6255e16b23350b5a989f9c82daf5282b28.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Call of Duty players can support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack in Season 1 of [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i]. Get the pack now![/p][p]Created in collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter, the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack is inspired by his story of courage, sacrifice, and resilience. Players will discover details influenced by Kyle's military service, including his own mottos featured on in-game weapons and other elements that honor his story.[/p][p]One hundred percent of Activision’s net proceeds for this special item, less VAT/sales tax, will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. For those of you who don’t know, the Endowment helps U.S. and U.K. veterans find high-quality jobs after their service. Since their founding in 2009, they have placed more than 180,000+ veterans into great jobs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]USAA Giveaway for U.S. Service Members and Veterans[/b][/p][p]And once again, USAA, a leading financial services company for the military, veterans and their families, has teamed up with the Call of Duty Endowment to offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], to U.S. military service members and veterans. It’s just one of the ways we can say thank you for your service to our country.[/p][p]Once you click the link for redemption below, you will be redirected to an [url="https://www.xnow.com/embedded/flow/usaa-cod-military-verification"]XNow account sign-in page[/url] to claim your prize. [url="https://www.callofdutyendowment.org/sweepstakes"]See official rules.[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Verify Your Email, Unlock “Locked Down” Weapon Camo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81ee798c48038aaa45f8002150a2b9125e43b172.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock the “Locked Down” Universal Weapon Camo simply by verifying your email! Verifying your Call of Duty account email helps strengthen security. Once you complete this verification, prepare to receive the following, added to your Call of Duty Account:[/p][p]For more info on email verification, [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/activision-account-email-verification"]visit our Activision Account Email Verification FAQ here.[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 Today! [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0de45a72bf28b7c11ccdbf0ba91f145349fe84cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 on Steam today[/url] and stay tuned for all your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel needs for Season 1 and beyond![/p]

newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]The final stretch of the 2026 PUBG Global Series is approaching: [b]PGS Circuit 4[/b]. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and the Circuit Final, PGS 12, the three remaining tournaments will bring this year’s 12-event PUBG Global Series to a close.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 4 is more than just the final circuit of the season. With the conclusion of PGS 12, the [b]final PGS Points standings for the 2026 season will be determined, deciding the eight teams that will advance to PUBG Global Championship 2026.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After three circuits of competition, the race for PGC is beginning to take shape—but nothing has been decided yet. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and double points on the line at PGS 12, there are still [b]240 PGS Points[/b] up for grabs.[/p][p align="start"]Which teams will earn their way to PGC 2026 through PGS Points? Let’s take a closer look at [b]Circuit 4, the final competition of the 2026 PGS season.[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/QYvMFGPC.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS Circuit 4 Schedule[/b][/h2][p align="start"]PGS Circuit 4 will take place from [b]October 14 to November 1[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]PGS 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Group Stage: October 14[/p][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: October 15[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 16[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 17–18[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 11[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winners Stage: October 22[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 23[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 24–25[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 12[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: October 29[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: October 30–November 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the [b]Circuit Final[/b], PGS 12 will see the top eight teams in the Circuit 4 PGS Points standings advance directly to the Grand Finals based on the points accumulated through PGS 10 and PGS 11. The remaining 16 teams will compete in the Survival Stage for the remaining spots in the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"]When PGS 12 comes to an end, it will mark not only the conclusion of Circuit 4, but also the end of the [b]2026 season-long PGS Points race spanning PGS 1 through PGS 12.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/dfU4pJIb.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b] [/p][h2][b]PGS Points Standings[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With three circuits and nine PGS events now complete, the battle for PGS Points is more intense than ever.[/p][p align="start"]At the conclusion of Circuit 3, [b]Virtus.pro leads the standings with 261 points[/b], followed by Made in Thailand with 224 points, 17Gaming with 223 points, and T1 with 208 points.[/p][p align="start"]Currently occupying the final PGC qualification spot is [b]Petrichor Road in eighth place with 152 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]But the gaps around the cutoff remain narrow. Seventh-place Falcons sit just two points ahead at 154, while ninth-place Gen.G Esports trail the current PGC qualification line by only seven points with 145.[/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, [b]Circuit 4 is still to come.[/b] The current standings are far from the final picture of who will advance to PGC.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/WQDtO1dg.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGC 2026 Qualification & PGS Points[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The [b]top eight teams in the final PGS Points standings[/b], accumulated across PGS 1 through PGS 12 during the 2026 season, will qualify for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And the final standings determine more than just qualification. The higher a team finishes in the PGS Points standings, the [b]later the stage from which they will begin their PGC 2026 journey.[/b][/p][p align="start"]The team finishing [b]1st in PGS Points will advance directly to the PGC 2026 Grand Finals[/b]. The [b]2nd-place team will enter at Survival Stage Day 1[/b], while the teams finishing [b]3rd through 8th will begin their journey in the Qualifying Stage[/b].[/p][p align="start"]This means Circuit 4 is about more than simply breaking into the Top 8. For teams already inside the qualification zone, the battle will continue until the very end as they fight for a higher PGS Points ranking and a more advantageous PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]240 PGS Points Are Still Up for Grabs[/b][/p][p align="start"]In both [b]PGS 10 and PGS 11[/b], the winner will earn [b]60 PGS Points[/b], with points awarded down through 16th place.[/p][p align="start"]At the Circuit Final, [b]PGS 12, the points will be doubled[/b]. The winner will earn 120 points, with 96 points going to second place, and double the PGS 10 and PGS 11 point values applied throughout the standings.[/p][p align="start"]That means the maximum number of points a single team can earn in Circuit 4 is:[/p][p align="start"][b]60 points (PGS 10 1st) + 60 points (PGS 11 1st) + 120 points (PGS 12 1st) = 240 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Considering the current gaps both inside and outside the PGC qualification zone, the three remaining tournaments leave plenty of room for the final standings to change.[/p][p align="start"]For teams outside the Top 8, Circuit 4 represents one final opportunity to make their move. For those already inside, it will be the final test to defend their position and secure a higher PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261012/lwSlSIQk.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS 10 Groups[/b][/h2][p align="start"]And it all begins with [b]PGS 10[/b].[/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage groups have been confirmed for the 24 teams competing in PGS 10. The teams have been divided into Groups A, B, and C through a [b]snake seeding format based on the final results of PGS 9.[/b][/p][p align="start"]PGS 9 winner Gen.G Esports has been placed in Group A, second-place T1 in Group B, and third-place Falcons in Group C. From there, the direction of placement alternates according to the PGS 9 standings, distributing all 24 teams across the three groups.[/p][list][*][p][b]Group A:[/b] Gen.G Esports, Made in Thailand, Virtus.pro, TEAM LIQUID, DN SOOPers, Sharper Esports, Team Vitality, Natus Vincere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B:[/b] T1, Alpha Gaming, Team Flash, eArena, Petrichor Road, FULL SENSE, TYLOO, JD Gaming[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C:[/b] Falcons, Geekay Esports, Anyone’s Legend, 17Gaming, FOUR ANGRY MEN, Twisted Minds, 09(Team Nemesis at PGS 9), Godlike[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="start"][b]\[Updated: October 12][/b][/p][p align="start"]Following GAM The Expendables’ withdrawal from PGS Circuit 4, Team Flash has been selected as the replacement team based on its placement in PVS Phase 1, in accordance with the existing team qualification criteria.[/p][p align="start"][i]※ Further updates will be provided if there are any changes to the tournament.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][h2][b]The Final Step to PGC[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The 2026 PUBG Global Series journey that began with PGS 1 now has just three tournaments remaining.[/p][p align="start"]There is still everything to play for after Circuit 3. With 60 points available at each of PGS 10 and PGS 11, followed by 120 points at PGS 12, [b]a total of 240 points remain on the table—and a single strong finish could reshape the race to PGC.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Which teams will finish inside the final Top 8 and earn their place at PGC 2026? And which team will rise to the very top of the standings to secure a direct seed to the [b]PGC Grand Finals[/b]?[/p][p align="start"]The final competition of the [b]2026 PUBG Global Series[/b] is about to begin.[/p][p align="start"][b]Tune in and cheer on your favorite teams as they make their final push toward PGC 2026![/b][/p]

newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d897bb630fb567f1b11e928a2b353031645abb21.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4[/i] is now live worldwide! In the epic Campaign, Price is on the run, conflict has erupted on the Korean Peninsula, and a catastrophic weapon of war is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands. [/p][p]Deploy across 20 Multiplayer maps at launch, including 12 new 6v6 maps, 4 Gunfight maps, 3 Ground War maps, and the new Kill Block modular training facility. Experience grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement, player choice, and greater control in every engagement. [/p][p]In the DMZ extraction mode, operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every deployment into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out. [/p][p]Keep reading for all the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launch intel you need, so that you’re fully prepared to kick off an incredible Modern Warfare experience. Here’s what you should know:[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Launch Comms[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3008575ab81f3d6ed17d6da730896927f975cee.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Do I Need to Know About Modern Warfare 4?[/h3][p][/p][p]Get up to speed on the major [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] beats:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/719041721925633150"]The Story So Far[/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1938090/announcements/detail/683013558653419697"]Campaign Trailer[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278033470"]All Multiplayer Operators, Weapons, Equipment, and Create-a-Class Features[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278035866"]Multiplayer Maps and Modes[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278033531"]Progression and Prestige[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540024688805804"]DMZ Deep Dive Part 1: Tour of Duty – Hajin Environments and Threats[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540659097208825"]DMZ Deep Dive Part 2: How to Play – Forward Operating Base (FOB)[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/692021394394843423"]PC Trailer, Tech Updates, and More[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Unlock More with the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381cdc27c05d5a93e83376c2a1b742a07de5ab03.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Extra Content Does the Vault Edition Include?[/h3][p][/p][p]Purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition for even more premium content with an exceptional value, including bonus rewards available only through this edition. Secure the Vault Edition to gain access to all included content, rewards, and edition-specific benefits:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i][/b] Digital Edition[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hunter Killer Operator Skin:[/b] Gain access to the Hunter Killer Operator Skin.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack:[/b] Gain access to Operator Skins for Price, Valeria, Ghost, and Blix.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Special Forces Operator Pack:[/b] Unlock the Special Forces Operator Pack, including Operator Skins representing the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and South Korea, each with voice packs in their local languages.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Signature Weapon Collection:[/b] Flex your loadout with the Signature Weapon Collection, featuring five different Signature weapons equipped with multiple Attachments including an Apex Attachment, including:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Voltspine” Kastov 762 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“La Sombra Venenosa” (“The Poisonous Shadow”) ISO Nightshade SMG Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Shattered Code” Rezi 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Volt-Edge” Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Sombra Besada” (“Shadow’s Kiss”) Combat Knife Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell* (One Season):[/b] Jump start your journey with BlackCell benefits including access to BlackCell content, the current Battle Pass, and up to 20 Tier Skips.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Deployment Bonus:[/b] Get a head start in DMZ with the DMZ Deployment Bonus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Upgrade to the Vault Edition[/b][/p][p]If you pre-ordered the Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, unlocking the many Vault Edition benefits detailed above.
[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Upgrade steps may vary by platform. Refer to your platform’s storefront for details.[/p][p][/p][h2]NEW: Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="tTKfKjWpxmA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Starting today, support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The pack will be available at launch in Multiplayer and DMZ before it releases in Call of Duty: Warzone™ with Season 1. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/valor"]Get the pack now.[/url][/p][p]Created in collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter, the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack brings the story you've seen throughout Forged in Valor into the game. Working closely with the Infinity Ward and Endowment teams, Cpl. Kyle (Ret.) helped shape a pack filled with personal references drawn from his life, service, recovery, and the mindset that continues to drive him forward.[/p][p]The Valor Pack includes the following in-game items:[/p][list][*][p]“Valor” Operator[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Relentless” Operator Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forged Resolve” M4 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Still Standing” Rezi 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Worth Fighting For” Combat Knife Melee Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Nice Try” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Steel Talon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forged in Valor” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Earned, Not Given” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Blood, Sweat, & Sand” Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Level XP Token  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token [/p][/*][/list][p][i]"There are two types of courage: the courage to act and the courage to endure."[/i] – Kyle Carpenter[/p][p][/p][p]From phrases that have guided him through adversity to details inspired by real moments from his military journey, every item reflects the resilience, determination, and optimism that define his story.[/p][p]Among the items is Kyle's favorite, the "Nice Try" Weapon Charm, a playful nod to the humor, attitude, and resilience that have become part of his story. While the pack honors remarkable acts of courage, it also captures the mantras that continue to drive Kyle forward today.[/p][p]One hundred percent of Activision’s net proceeds will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. For those of you who don’t know, the Endowment helps U.S. and U.K. veterans find high-quality jobs after their service. Since their founding in 2009, they have placed more than 180,000+ veterans into great jobs. [/p][p][/p][p][b]USAA GIVEAWAY FOR U.S. SERVICE MEMBERS AND VETERANS[/b][/p][p]Once again, USAA has teamed up with the Call of Duty Endowment to offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], to U.S. military service members and veterans. It’s just one of the ways we can say thanks for your service in our country.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.xnow.com/embedded/flow/usaa-cod-military-verification"]Click here for redemption[/url] to be redirected to an XNow account sign-in page to claim your prize.[/p][p] [/p][p]Eligibility: U.S. active and former military members only. While supplies last. Quantities limited. XNow account required. See the official rules here.[/p][p][/p][h2]Link Your Discord Account[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/97f45a2683d2abd6ddd2b58d39f322f69782b499.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are adding new Discord features to [i]Call of Duty[/i]! By linking your account, you will have direct access to your Discord friends and have the ability to send invites directly from the game. As a thank you, players who link their accounts will receive a bonus Calling Card. [/p][p] [/p][p]For players who linked their Activision and Discord accounts during the Beta: with the launch of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you will need to link your account again to access these functionalities. Your bonus Calling Card will already be in your inventory, and you will also be given 1-hour Double XP and 1 hour Double Weapon XP. [/p][p] [/p][p]Follow these steps to link (or re-link) your account:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://profile.activision.com/login?locale=en&redirectUrl=https://profile.activision.com/login?locale%3Den&theme=activision.com&loginToken=fd19af0c-5919-b753-7639-93609fc4ca8d&recaptcha=true"]Sign in to the Activision account[/url] used to play [i]Call of Duty[/i].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Open Account Linking and select Discord.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sign into the Discord account you want to link, and if you agree to link your account, hit authorize.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Return to Call of Duty and restart the game for the connection to take effect and the new features to become available.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]If you're playing on PC, you can also follow the instructions within the game under the Discord tab in your Social menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 Today![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06286aae5407416d91970777d6eefd1a3b2590a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 today[/url] and stay tuned to the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog"]Call of Duty Blog[/url] for all your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel needs at launch and beyond![/p]
